Create a sprawling classical garden complex with a dreamlike character, floating as a group of irregular islands in calm blue water beneath a soft pink-blue sky and encircled by a hazy mountainous horizon. Make its central network more rectilinear and tightly interwoven, then open it outward into broad, organically curved lawns around the perimeter. Throughout, densely but orderly interconnect pale stone walkways, lawns, courtyards, canals, ponds, bridges, terraces, and low garden structures.

Cluster architecture beside waterways, oriented toward gardens or pools. Make most structures low walls, arcades, gateways, covered passages, and rounded pavilions rather than enclosed multistory buildings. Finish peach and cream stucco with pink stone trim, decorative bands, fluted columns, brick-lined arches, and balustrades; include occasional pergolas carrying vines and hanging purple flowers. Run narrow turquoise canals and rounded lily ponds throughout, beneath small bridges, raised archways, and open colonnades. Link different levels with several short waterfalls or spillways. Border the main landmass with wide, pale cobbled promenades and curving retaining walls; keep water-filled inlets between its projecting garden lobes.

Set several separate circular pavilion islands offshore. Build each from concentric grassy terraces and arched perimeter walls, crowned by a small, domed open gazebo. Plant the lawns formally but with variety: clipped hedges, flower beds, topiary, tall slender trees, willows, flowering trees, shrubs, urn planters, and scattered circular planting beds. Combine occasional elevated trellises, lush saturated grass, sunlit bright masonry, and glossy reflective water to produce a serene, ornate, slightly fantastical atmosphere.

=== THE TASK ===
Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density
and arrangement the description calls for. Budget is 800 tool calls and 180
minutes; every tool result reports how much of both you have spent. Spend as
much or as little as the job needs, and decide for yourself when the scene
matches the description.

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt:
Create a sprawling classical garden complex with a dreamlike character, floating as a group of irregular islands in calm blue water beneath a soft pink-blue sky and encircled by a hazy mountainous horizon. Make its central network more rectilinear and tightly interwoven, then open it outward into broad, organically curved lawns around the perimeter. Throughout, densely but orderly interconnect pale stone walkways, lawns, courtyards, canals, ponds, bridges, terraces, and low garden structures.

Cluster architecture beside waterways, oriented toward gardens or pools. Make most structures low walls, arcades, gateways, covered passages, and rounded pavilions rather than enclosed multistory buildings. Finish peach and cream stucco with pink stone trim, decorative bands, fluted columns, brick-lined arches, and balustrades; include occasional pergolas carrying vines and hanging purple flowers. Run narrow turquoise canals and rounded lily ponds throughout, beneath small bridges, raised archways, and open colonnades. Link different levels with several short waterfalls or spillways. Border the main landmass with wide, pale cobbled promenades and curving retaining walls; keep water-filled inlets between its projecting garden lobes.

Set several separate circular pavilion islands offshore. Build each from concentric grassy terraces and arched perimeter walls, crowned by a small, domed open gazebo. Plant the lawns formally but with variety: clipped hedges, flower beds, topiary, tall slender trees, willows, flowering trees, shrubs, urn planters, and scattered circular planting beds. Combine occasional elevated trellises, lush saturated grass, sunlit bright masonry, and glossy reflective water to produce a serene, ornate, slightly fantastical atmosphere.
